2. This application has been filed for quashing the order dated 11/06/2019 passed in Parbatta P.S.
Case No. 102/2000, G.R. NO. 873/2000, registered for the offence under Sections 494/498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act by which learned S.D.J.M.,
Khagaria has rejected the discharge petition filed by the petitioner on 29/08/2018 under section 239 of the Cr.P.C.
